tagline: INDONESIA'S GATEWAY TO FURNITURE AND CRAFT.

highlights.title: 2,500+ verified suppliers
highlights.body: HIMKI positions itself as a gateway connecting global buyers, investors and partners with Indonesian manufacturers and artisans.

highlights.title: 18 production regions
highlights.body: The association maps major furniture and craft production hubs across Indonesia.

highlights.title: USD 6B export vision
highlights.body: HIMKI communicates an industry ambition to grow furniture and craft exports toward USD 6 billion by 2031.

highlights.title: Industry bridge
highlights.body: HIMKI connects business, government and global markets to strengthen competitiveness, design, sustainability and export readiness.
